SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

3. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   D. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

6. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

   D. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   B. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   B. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   D. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   C. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

13. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   C. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

   C. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   C. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

16. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.

   C. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

22. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
